title: Define one lifecycle, versioning and impact process for semantic artefacts
requirements:
- Establish controlled publication statuses (draft, trial use, normative, deprecated, retired) with permitted uses
- Add a common lifecycle from authoring to retirement for models, terminologies and mappings
- Add a taxonomy of terminology artefacts and their services
- Add dependency, impact and compatibility management as an explicit cross-cutting capability
- State version alignment of terminologies and value sets across consuming systems as a conformance expectation
- Rename 'minimum dataset' to minimum metadata for governed artefacts
- Define version semantics per artefact type, compatibility classification, and version alignment across participating systems
- Make dependency tracking and impact analysis mandatory for production-used artefacts
